Taylor G.: Quick follow-up from the 03/18 postmortem. We need to lock remediation owners, timeline, and decide how to treat the SLO window while we ship fixes.
Ishaan R.: I can take runtime (KV eviction + hotspot detection). ETA 72h for a staged change + perf run.
Maya L.: Ill own autoscaler tweaks and dashboard updates. Plan: add a burst counter, shorten scale-up cooldown, and add an internal buffer tile. ETA 48h.
Taylor G.: For SLO handling I propose we keep the public SLO intact, and create an internal "buffered p95" at 280ms for ops/error-budget math for 14 days. Public dashboard gets an incident flag.
Ishaan R.: Agreed. Internal buffer avoids burning customer error budgets. Ill add the incident flag to trace metadata.
Maya L.: Will add an internal-only dashboard tile and push an alert to staging:
```
alert: BufferedP95Alert
expr: service:inference_p95_ms > 280
for: 5m
labels: {severity: "page"}
annotations: {runbook: "https://go/redwood/runbooks/kv-hotspot"}
```
Maya L.: Also will update the public SLO note: "Incident window 2026-03-18; see incident 2026-0318".
OncallBot: Incident 2026-03-18 | error-budget-impact: 4.2% | current p95: 312ms | runbook: https://go/redwood/incident/2026-0318
Taylor G.: Action items: Ishaan -> runtime PR + perf job (3d), Maya -> autoscale + dashboard + alert (2d), Taylor -> canary plan + rollback thresholds (1d). Add ETAs to the postmortem ticket and tag @oncall for rollout window.
Ishaan R.: Draft PR: https://git.redwood/runtime/pulls/1730 - includes eviction change and hotspot metrics. Perf job running.
Maya L.: Infra PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/1120 - adds burst counter and cooldown change. Staging tile: https://dash.redwood/s/ops/p95-buffered. Canary ready when runtime patch lands.
Taylor G.: Canary checklist: update internal SLO docs, canary = 5% traffic, rollback if p95 > 350ms for 10m or error-rate up by 0.5%. Scheduling 10:00 UTC canary tomorrow.
Ishaan R.: Perf run shows ~18% tail improvement on synthetic. Will finalize PR tomorrow morning.
Maya L.: No blockers. Ill notify CS for the public dashboard note.
Taylor G.: Thanks team. Well reconvene after canary to decide whether to keep the buffered SLO for the 14-day window or restore original thresholds. Logging closure items in the postmortem ticket now. :thumbsup:
